summary:
status: partial (gate mapped, live dry-run **aborted** on read-only grounds — see Blocker B0). Zero writes confirmed.

**Repo / auth**
- Repo exists: `kolisachint/inkuno` ✓ (currently bref-branded fork content; rename is a separate lane).
- Auth: logged in as `kolisachint`, scopes `gist, read:org, repo, workflow` — sufficient for `gh release create` (repo) + `gh workflow run` (workflow). No extra secrets: `release-native.yml` uses only `github.token` (`contents: write` on validate/publish jobs) + apt packages; macOS signing is ad-hoc, no Developer account.
- No conflicts: local tags = only `nightly`; `git ls-remote --tags origin` = only `nightly`; `gh release list` = only the `nightly` pre-release. No `v0.0.1` tag or draft anywhere, so no `RESUME=1` path needed.

**scripts/release.sh — full read (manual 0.0.1 path)**
- Real run (from synced `main`, clean tree): sets `Cargo.toml` version → `cargo update -p bref --offline` → `cargo test --locked` → commits `Cargo.toml`+`Cargo.lock` (`chore: release X.Y.Z`) → `git tag -a vX.Y.Z` → atomic `git push origin main <tag>` → `gh release create --draft` (if none) → `gh workflow run release-native.yml -f tag=…`. Then `release-native.yml` validates tag/version/draft, builds mac DMG (`macos-latest`, universal via `lipo`, `bundle-macos.sh`+`hdiutil`) and Linux tarball (`ubuntu-22.04`, GPUI apt deps), and `publish-release.py` attaches exactly `bref-macos.dmg` + `bref-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` (+SHA256SUMS) before publishing. Label gate (`release-gate.yml`) never creates 0.0.1 — manual script is the correct and only vehicle. `bash -n` syntax check: OK.
- DRY_RUN=1 path: skips branch check, skips `gh api` release lookup, skips `git fetch`, exits before push/release/dispatch — so **no network writes, no git writes**. BUT it is not filesystem-read-only: `perl -pi -e` rewrites `Cargo.toml`, `cargo update --offline` rewrites `Cargo.lock`, `cargo test --locked --offline` writes `target/`; tracked files are restored by an EXIT trap (net-zero on success). Kill -9/OOM between edit and trap = dirty tree.

**Dry-run output**
- NOT EXECUTED — aborted per the "abort if unsure" rule: the script is provably network/git-safe in dry-run but provably *not* mutation-free on disk, and this tree is mandated READ-ONLY. Static substitute: control-flow verified above; dry-run would print generated notes (from `git log`, no CHANGELOG.md exists) + `git diff --stat` of the bumped files, then restore.

**Blocker checklist (owners)**
- B0 — Dry-run deferred (crew): re-run `DRY_RUN=1 scripts/release.sh 0.0.1` inside a throwaway copy (not this worktree) or accept the static analysis. Concrete: `cp -r` tree to /tmp, run there; or run here only after the read-only constraint is lifted.
- B1 — Wrong repo remote (user/crew): this worktree's `origin` = `kolisachint/noteapp.git`, and branch = `agent/release-gate`. The **real** script must run from an `inkuno`-repo checkout on synced `main` — never here (it would push tag+commit to noteapp). Vehicle `agent/inkuno-0.0.1` must first merge to inkuno `main` with green CI.
- B2 — `INKUNO_REPO` unset (user at release time): script default `REPO=OWNER/inkuno` placeholder. Must `export INKUNO_REPO=kolisachint/inkuno` when running, or edit `REPO` (integration lane).
- B3 — Version semantics sign-off (user): `Cargo.toml` is `0.4.7` (app `bref`); releasing `0.0.1` is a deliberate downgrade. Mechanically fine; needs owner confirmation.
- B4 — Asset naming expectation (user/rename crew): 0.0.1 assets will be `bref-*` named (`Bref.app`, `bref-macos.dmg`, `bref-linux-x86_64.tar.gz`) — intentionally untouched per RELEASING.md. Not a pipeline blocker, but decide before publish whether rename must land first.
- Non-blockers: Linux can't build on this Mac (no docker/cross, arm64-only; only `aarch64-apple-darwin` target installed) — by design, Linux builds on the `ubuntu-22.04` runner; mac universal target installed by CI. First hosted run still needed to validate runners end-to-end. Cargo registry cache is populated, so offline `cargo test` rehearsal should work.

**Zero writes/push confirmation**: only reads were issued — `gh auth status`, `gh repo view`, `gh release list`, `git ls-remote --tags`, local `git status/log/tag/branch/remote -v`, file reads, `bash -n`, `rustup target list --installed`, `ls` of cargo cache. Final `git status --porcelain` = empty (tree still clean). No edits, commits, tags, pushes, releases, or workflow dispatches.
